columns.name: CONTRACT_ID
columns.description: System generated primary key.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to PER_PERSONS.

columns.name: REFERENCE
columns.description: Same as assignment number (for the row that represents work terms).

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: The type of contract.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: The status of the contract.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Specifies the action performed on the particular record. For example: HIRE.

columns.name: STATUS_REASON
columns.description: The reason for the contracts existence.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the contract.

columns.name: DURATION
columns.description: The duration of the contract.

columns.name: DURATION_UNITS
columns.description: The units of time in which the duration is expressed.

columns.name: CONTRACTUAL_JOB_TITLE
columns.description: The contractual job title - N.B. not related to PER_JOBS.

columns.name: PARTIES
columns.description: The signatory parties (other than the employee).

columns.name: START_REASON
columns.description: The reason for the contracts existence.

columns.name: END_REASON
columns.description: The reason for ending the contract.

columns.name: LEGISLATION_CODE
columns.description: LEGISLATION_CODE

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_EXTENSIONS
columns.description: The number of times the contract has been extended.

columns.name: EXTENSION_REASON
columns.description: The reason for extending the contract.

columns.name: EXTENSION_PERIOD
columns.description: The period of time for which the contract has been extended.

columns.name: EXTENSION_PERIOD_UNITS
columns.description: The units of time in which the extension period has been expressed.

columns.name: CONTRACT_END_DATE
columns.description: The date the contract is expected to end

columns.name: CONTRACT_NUMBER
columns.description: Uniquely identifies a contract. If there are multiple contracts under a work relationship,sequence value will be incremented

columns.name: PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID
columns.description: Identifies the Employment Level. One to many relationship from PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE
